description: PARTIAL SAVE: writes ONLY the 'TitleCustomData' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel; all other v1/v2 fields stay untouched. SCHEMA + limits for the title-wide key-value store (feature flags, project-wide globals, event state, balancing knobs that don't fit any typed definition below). This section holds ONLY the key schema — the VALUES live in the TitleCustomData store, one document per title, managed with the dedicated title-data tools (get_title_data / save_title_data). Each key declares a Scope (Static = authored config; Runtime = mutable state written only by CloudCode scripts) and a Bucket (Public = readable by game clients; Private = server/CloudCode only).

x-enum-descriptions: Arbitrary string. Validated by length only.
Integer. Must parse as long via long.TryParse. Returned to the client as a string.
Boolean. Must be "true" or "false" (case-insensitive, via bool.TryParse).
Valid JSON document. Any structure parseable via JToken.Parse. Size limited by MaxValueLengthBytes.

TitleCustomDataKeyDefinition.description: Definition of a single registered TitleCustomData key: its scope, bucket and validation rules.

Bucket.description: Visibility bucket: Public (readable by game clients) or Private (server/CloudCode only). Fixed by config.

DefaultValue.description: Default value materialized on read when the record does not exist or has expired. Never written to the DB until an explicit write. null means absent keys stay absent.

Description.description: Developer-facing description of the key's purpose. Does not affect validation.

KeyID.description: Unique key identifier across all scopes and buckets. Must not contain '.' or '$'.

MaxValueLengthBytes.description: Hard value size limit in bytes (UTF-8) for this key. Overrides TitleCustomDataDefinitions.DefaultMaxValueLengthBytes.

Scope.description: Storage scope: Static (authored config, written via the management backend / AI Coder) or Runtime (mutable state, written only by CloudCode). Fixed by config.

TtlSeconds.description: Key TTL in seconds. null means permanent. On write the server sets ExpiresAt = now + TtlSeconds; expired records are filtered on read.

ValueType.description: Expected value format: String, Int, Bool or Json. Validated on every write. Counters used with CloudCode's IncrementTitleCustomData must be declared as Int.

x-enum-descriptions: Readable by every player through the client TitleCustomData endpoint. Examples: event schedule, global progress, public feature flags.
Never returned to clients. Server code and CloudCode scripts only. Examples: server-side thresholds, anti-fraud settings, internal counters.
Authored configuration. Written by the management backend (publisher dashboard, AI Coder's SaveTitleData) and cached like the rest of the title config. CloudCode can read it but never write it.
Mutable title state. Written ONLY by CloudCode and always read straight from the database (never cached), so a counter read right after a write is correct.

value.description: Schema and limits of the title-wide key-value store. The VALUES live in the separate TitleCustomData collection (one document per title), not in this config section. Each key declares a Scope (Static = authored config; Runtime = mutable state written only by CloudCode scripts) and a Bucket (Public = readable by game clients; Private = server/CloudCode only). Clients can never write this store.

DefaultMaxValueLengthBytes.description: Default value size limit in bytes (UTF-8) for unregistered keys. Registered keys use their own MaxValueLengthBytes. Recommended: 8192 (8 KB).

DefaultTtlSeconds.description: Default TTL in seconds for unregistered keys. null means no TTL. Expired records are filtered on read and purged on the next write.

Keys.description: Schema-managed keys of the TitleCustomData store. Dictionary key is TitleCustomDataKeyDefinition.KeyID. A definition pins the key's Scope (Static/Runtime) and Bucket (Public/Private) — writes to another scope/bucket are rejected. Unregistered keys are free-form unless RejectUnregisteredKeys is true.

MaxKeysPerBucket.description: Maximum number of keys per (scope, bucket) pair — Static.Public, Static.Private, Runtime.Public, Runtime.Private. Protects the title document from unbounded growth. Recommended: 256.

MaxTotalSizeBytes.description: Total size limit of the whole title store (both scopes, both buckets) in bytes. Protects against MongoDB's 16 MB document limit. Recommended: 4,000,000 (~4 MB).

RejectUnregisteredKeys.description: If true, writes to unregistered keys are rejected (strict schema mode). If false (default), unregistered keys are accepted as free-form with the default limits.
